answer: Resist sybils with funding-source-linked reward dilution: the network traces each identity's stake to its funding origin and publishes an atlas of treasury clusters. Identities sharing one source split a single reward pool, so ten thousand clones funded from one harbor of capital earn no more together than one honest agent. An attacker crossing a dune of fake names gains nothing by multiplying identities: each new sybil dilutes its siblings, and only fresh, independently funded identities earn fresh rewards.
